thread:
Maya Li: FYI — Cogentix just submitted an onboarding request for a custom 7B model to run in Private (VPC). Key asks: Redwood-managed KMS, HSM-backed keys, PHI-safe logging, and a pre-rollout regression + safety eval. They called out renewal sensitivity: if p95 latency >180ms or hallucination incidents >1.5% renewal flagged as high risk.

Jonah Kim: can you share the model export and whether they want quantized variants? also need their preferred GPU class and expected qps.

Maya Li: artifact: s3://cogentix/models/cgx-7b-v2.tar.gz. They want two variants: q4_0 (4-bit) and fp16 baseline. Target load: 60 QPS peak, 10 QPS steady. They asked for warm KV cache behavior to be preserved across restarts.

Priya Sharma: I need the eval sets. send the clinical redaction set + 300 hallucination probes. My safety suite (safety-v2 + entailment checks) will run. If you need strict PHI masking heuristics, note that we apply both regex and model-based detectors.

Maya Li: granted: s3://cogentix/evals/cgx_clinical_v2.tar.gz (3k prompts, golden labels + redact flags). hallucination set at s3://cogentix/evals/halluc_probes_300.jsonl. SLOs in the request: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 180ms, hallucination rate < 1.5%, cost per 1k tok < $3.50.

Jonah Kim: infra note: for 7B q4 we can support with T4s or A10G for cost efficiency; fp16 baseline should run on A100/H100 for consistent latency. For 60 QPS peak we recommend a cluster: 3x A10G for q4 canary, scale to 6 if traffic grows. For fp16 prod: 2x A100 with autoscaler. If they require locked HSM we need Legal sign-off on the managed-HSM addendum. That addendum also changes support hours.

Priya Sharma: schedule: I can kick off safety/regression once I have read perms. Expect an initial report in ~48 hours (smoke) and a full pass in 5 business days. Please tag me in the ticket when upload done.

Tina Wu: if Redwood hosts HSM, we need the customer to sign the HSM clause and accept the SLA delta. I can prepare the addendum today but need the customer company legal contact.

Maya Li: customer legal = legal@cogentix.io. I'll email them now with the template and CC Tina. Also set up enablement: they want a runbook walkthrough and failover plan — proposed Wed 11am PT.

infra-bot: Ticket created: CS-7991 - cogentix 7B private onboarding. Assignees: Jonah Kim, Priya Sharma, Tina Wu. Due: initial smoke report in 2 business days.

Jonah Kim: quick rollout sketch — small canary then ramp if metrics OK:

```
canary:
  variant: q4_0
  nodes: 3 (A10G)
  traffic: 10%
monitoring: [p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, hallucination_rate, error_rate]
criteria_to_ramp:
  - hallucination_rate < 1.5%
  - p95_latency < 180ms
  - error_rate stable
ramp:
  - to: 100%
    duration: 24h
fallback: roll back to baseline-fp16 and route to fallback-region
```

Priya Sharma: add a hard stop: if hallucination_rate increases by 30% relative to baseline test, rollback immediately. Also include targeted prompts to track known failure patterns.

Maya Li: action items:
- Jonah: produce infra cost estimate (A10G vs A100) and cluster sizing for 60 QPS.
- Priya: run smoke safety/regression on the eval set and post initial findings to CS-7991.
- Tina: prepare HSM addendum and confirm SLA impact, then ping customer legal.
- Maya: schedule enablement Wed 11am PT and update CRM with renewal sensitivity.

Jonah Kim: noted. I'll post a cost/latency tradeoff matrix once I finish the estimate.

Priya Sharma: I'll start the smoke tests as soon as permissions set, will include hallucination probe breakdown and a small golden-label accuracy table.

Maya Li: thanks team. tagging @cogentix contact when legal email sent. will update thread with signed addendum and enablement invite. :thumbsup:
